summary.kagiParserBranch: passes on b9374d14b8 and is no longer expected-red

buckets.name: side-effect outputs
buckets.whyUnreachable: The rule says the member creates a side effect rather than a scalar plot value. Current validation does not yet inspect alert/log/strategy side effects or all drawing setter payload deltas as rule-owned outputs.
buckets.wouldAnotherValidatorReach: Yes, split across event/log payload, strategy ledger/order/risk payload, and drawing mutation payload checks.

buckets.name: trace/provider/host or opaque scalars
buckets.whyUnreachable: Values depend on live quotes, realtime barstate/timenow, provider feeds, footprint rows, recommendations, session calendar, pseudo-random sequences, or margin/liquidation behavior.
buckets.wouldAnotherValidatorReach: Mostly no without traces/provider fixtures; some can only get shape checks.

buckets.name: locally constructible scalar single-target cases
buckets.whyUnreachable: No current known-good output isolates the member.
buckets.wouldAnotherValidatorReach: Yes; extra single-target cases should validate them directly.

buckets.name: handle payload or isolated handle cases
buckets.whyUnreachable: The member returns or copies a drawing/chart-point handle; current scalar validator cannot inspect a handle value directly, and payload validation only sees emitted drawings.
buckets.wouldAnotherValidatorReach: Partly, through a handle-aware validator or isolated getter/copy cases.

buckets.name: collection-return payload cases
buckets.whyUnreachable: The member returns a collection and current validation does not inspect returned collection payload ownership for these rows.
buckets.wouldAnotherValidatorReach: Partly; request/provider rows may remain evidence-bound.

buckets.name: color payload/domain cases
buckets.whyUnreachable: chart.bg_color and chart.fg_color are color-valued host/context members; current color-domain validation reads emitted payload colors, not host color values.
buckets.wouldAnotherValidatorReach: Partly; exact host color values remain context/trace-bound except documented default cases.

buckets.name: blocked by current expected-red
buckets.whyUnreachable: ticker.kagi cannot be validated on this branch because the standalone two-argument Kagi value case still fails here.
buckets.wouldAnotherValidatorReach: Yes, after parser-lane Kagi fix lands on this branch.
